content: Hi! How can I help you with your files today?
Hey! Could you send me the meeting recording from this morning? I want to revisit a few points.

Of course! I've placed the recording and the updated slide deck in our shared folder labeled 'Team_Meeting_2024-06-14'. Here's the link: <shared_folder_link>. Feel free to browse or download whichever files you need.
Thank you! Is the folder view-only or can I move things around a bit?
You have edit access, so you're welcome to organize or add notes. Just a heads up, if you make changes, maybe add 'v2' to any updated files for easy tracking.
Great idea, I'll keep that in mind. Are the recordings labeled clearly?
Yes, they follow the format 'Meeting_Recording_2024-06-14_v1.mp4' and 'Slides_2024-06-14.pdf'. If you need subtitles for the video, I can add a version with captions, just let me know!
That would be wonderful. Also, should I add alt text to any images in the slide deck?
That's a thoughtful step! If you upload a new version with alt text, please save it as 'Slides_2024-06-14_v2_accessible.pdf'. The accessibility guide in the folder can help with quick tips.
Perfect, downloading the originals now. Thanks for organizing everything so neatly.
You're very welcome! Let me know if you need a zipped export for offline use, or if there's anything missing. Your attention to accessibility is appreciated.
I'll check the folder and upload an updated deck with alt text later today.
Sounds great! Feel free to click into the 'Templates' subfolder for an index file, it can help track versions or file notes. Thanks for collaborating so thoughtfully!
